evidence.quote: In light of that fact, I expect the FOMC to maintain an accommodative policy for some time.
Now is the time we need to be patient, steely-eyed central bankers, and not be head-faked by temporary data surprises.
the factors putting upward pressure on inflation are temporary, and an accommodative monetary policy continues to have an important role to play in supporting the recovery.
the U.S. economy is hitting the gas and continuing to make a very strong recovery from the severe COVID-19 recession.
some of the labor market's cylinders are firing away, and some are still sputtering, so monetary accommodation continues to be warranted.
For these reasons, I expect that inflation will exceed 2 percent this year and next year. After that, it should return to target.

parsed.rationale: Despite describing a booming economy and above-target inflation, the speaker frames inflation pressures as transitory, stresses labor-market shortfalls, and explicitly urges patience and continued accommodation. The net signal is a moderate dovish lean, tempered by acknowledgment of strong growth and possibly persistent price pressures.
